name: University of Münster
header:
University of Münster
Germany · MSc Mathematics Münster; Mathematics Münster Graduate School doctoral positions
Selected European research fit; not a US News ranked-program claim.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• The November 1, 2026 doctoral call has already closed.
• Full Grant funding is a separate May 31 application with two letters; ordinary MSc admission alone does not
request them.
• A US bachelor’s does not automatically satisfy the doctoral degree requirement.
• Keep the academic admission, scholarship email and doctoral-job workflows separate.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a recognized mathematics/comparable bachelor’s of at least six semesters, including120 ECTS in
mathematics; final German-equivalent grade3.0 or better (department says US GPA2.0 equivalent). Provisional
transcripts may be submitted with3.3 or better, but final degree is required for enrollment. UChicago is a
plausible degree route; credit equivalence is assessed, not automatic. Doctoral calls normally presuppose
master’s-level qualification; direct UChicago bachelor eligibility is not established. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
For MSc, prepare CV, transcripts/syllabi, English evidence and the department questionnaire; complete online
application, then follow its emailed upload checklist. Submit the separate full-grant request if seeking funding.
If Chinese/Indian/Vietnamese academic history or nationality applies, clarify APS requirements for a US-earned
degree. For a doctorate, identify at least two local investigators and wait for an open call; the November 2026
round has closed. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For MSc, no advance adviser acceptance is required; questionnaire records mentor preference. Doctoral
applicants must name at least two local investigators. Active investigators below include professors and
nonprofessorial researchers; the latter’s independent-supervision authority and 2027 availability must be
confirmed. [s3] [s6] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc has a two-stage workflow: submit the online form, receive an emailed check sheet/application number,
then finish mandatory and optional-or-waived uploads in the info portal. Once complete, files cannot be
exchanged by the applicant. Multiple online submissions leave only the highest application number valid.
Check status weekly. Doctoral calls use a distinct online form. [s2] [s6]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Doctoral autumn 2026 deadline and latest autumn 2027 start are explicit, and the call is already closed as of
November 5. MSc admission and Full Grant use standing annual dates; the detailed scholarship PDF is 2026,
not a newly announced 2027 competition. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s25]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc winter entry: May-July 15, standing annual schedule; no exact 2027 clock/time zone published. Early round
ends around late May/early June. Summer: November-January 15, with first round November 30; the central
calendar explicitly includes January 15, 2027. Doctoral autumn 2026 call: November 1, 2026, now closed; start
no later than autumn 2027. Spring 2027 call date is not yet established. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s24]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc Full Grant: May 31 annually, earlier than the ordinary July 15 admission deadline;2027 call not yet
independently posted. Doctoral funding and position application share the call deadline; the November 1, 2026
round has already closed. No 2027 spring deadline is inferred. [s4] [s5] [s25]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Full Grant: two professor letters sent directly by May 31 annual deadline; no separate grace or clock published.
Doctoral call: at least two letters by November 1, 2026, same as the closed application deadline. Ordinary MSc
checklist does not request letters. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English proof is part of the required application uploads. The MSc portal check sheet specifies the upload
deadline; do not assume a later score grace period. No GRE requirement is listed. Doctoral English evidence
was due with the closed November 1 call. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete mandatory MSc uploads by the individual check-sheet deadline; final bachelor’s certificate must be
available at enrollment. Originals plus certified German/English translations are combined in one PDF up to2MB
where translation is required. Doctoral call required complete degree/transcript/English materials by its
deadline. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
MSc enrollment/acceptance date is individual and not established here. Doctoral offers arrive by email:
acknowledge receipt promptly; hiring preparation begins at least eight weeks before the agreed start. No
universal April 15 commitment protection is stated. [s2] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc English B2: TOEFL iBT>=72 on the old scale, IELTS>=6.0, or an English-language bachelor’s. No German
requirement is listed for this English MSc. Doctoral call asks fluent English, no German; certificates or
transcripts showing English instruction/coursework are accepted. [s1] [s5] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
The MSc explicitly accepts an English-language bachelor’s, so a completed UChicago degree fits. Confirmation
is still needed for the proof accepted while the degree is pending. Doctoral FAQ also accepts English-taught
coursework recorded in the transcript; no separate test is automatically needed under that route. [s1] [s5]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No GRE requirement appears in the complete public MSc checklist or doctoral call. Optional score consideration
is not expressly described; do not assume a score upload is requested. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: bachelor’s/provisional certificate and transcript with grades/GPA; syllabus or course descriptions
document the mathematical content. Doctoral call: copies of bachelor’s and master’s certificates and full
transcripts. The mathematics-credit requirement needs an ECTS-equivalence assessment of UChicago quarter
courses. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required questionnaire records degree subject, major/minor, grade, institution and graduation year; select
three intended specializations and indicate whether their prerequisites are already satisfied. It also asks
whether you prefer a theoretical or applied mentor. [s3]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Syllabus/course descriptions are explicitly included among MSc evidence of academic achievements. No
separate page limit is public; central translated-document uploads have a2MB PDF limit. Follow the
program-specific slots. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: no letters on the published required checklist. Full Grant scholarship: two university-professor
letters. Doctoral call: at least two recommendation letters. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
The Full Grant adds two professor references to the ordinary MSc application. The doctoral referee guidance
asks, in paraphrase, about relationship duration, mathematical/intellectual ability, independence, work
habits/teamwork, English, and willingness to host the applicant at the referee’s own institution. [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
No automatic invitation is documented for these routes. The applicant personally arranges direct referee email:
scholarship letters to mm.scholarships@uni-muenster.de; doctoral letters to
mm.applications@uni-muenster.de. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters are independently emailed and need not wait for academic submission under the published process.
Ensure staff can match the applicant and route; the full-grant email subject must include FULL-GRANT. [s4] [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Doctoral online application generates an automatic confirmation, but this does not establish letter receipt. The
MSc info portal tracks academic-application status; a separate public scholarship/doctoral letter checklist was
not established. Request receipt confirmation from the relevant office if needed. [s2] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Automatic cross-route/cycle reuse and replacement of a received letter are not promised. Referees should
send fresh route-specific PDFs or ask the receiving office. MSc applicant uploads lock when the file is complete;
only the Master’s Office can exchange them afterward. [s2] [s5]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required for MSc and doctoral applications. No public length/font/spacing rule; upload under the corresponding
form instructions. [s1] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc checklist has no separate SOP. Doctoral application requires a cover letter, without a public

word/page limit or detailed prompt; explain research fit and name at least two local investigators as required
elsewhere in the form. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate required document is specified in the MSc checklist, Full Grant instructions or doctoral call.
Optional attachment/link permission and any live-form limit remain unverified. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
MSc questionnaire selects three specializations and prerequisite readiness. Doctoral application must identify
at least two potential local supervisors; no standalone research-interest essay limit is published. [s3] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Doctoral applicants are invited to include examples of academic work where appropriate. No public length/file
cap or instruction to upload rather than link was established. Ordinary MSc checklist does not require a thesis
or paper. [s1] [s6]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Complete the currently linked two-page questionnaire and attach it; also provide transcript/syllabus evidence.
The questionnaire is not replaced by a freeform course list. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Full Grant requires a separate motivation letter explaining why you want to pursue the Münster MSc (prompt
paraphrase). Send with the funding request to mm.scholarships@uni-muenster.de, subject containing
FULL-GRANT. No published word/page/font/spacing rule. Second-year renewal later requires a two-page
activity report and transcript. [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No further public short-answer essay was identified beyond the questionnaire, funding motivation and doctoral
cover letter. The academic portal may require additional program-specific uploads shown only after application
submission. [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc Full Grant: EUR992/month, equivalent to EUR11,904 over12 funded months (arithmetic), plus a one-time
origin-dependent travel allowance and semester fee. Competitive, not automatic. Doctoral positions:75% TV-L
E13 employment for three years; exact annual gross/net euro amount depends on pay scale/step and is not
published in the call. MSc tuition is zero; winter 2026-27 semester fee EUR369.50, not a confirmed 2027-28
charge. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s8]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full Grant is12+12 months, with second-year renewal conditional on positive review of the report/transcript.
Doctoral employment is three years, not a general guarantee of all time needed for completion. [s4] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Full Grant targets international master’s students; first degree must be completed before funding starts, and
prior residence in Germany cannot exceed12 months during the preceding three years. US F-1 status alone
does not violate that condition. Doctoral call welcomes applicants regardless of nationality. [s4] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full Grant selection considers academic excellence/motivation and may include an online interview; renewal
requires progress review. Doctoral employment supports research and may include teaching: the standing
funding page says up to3 hours/week for 75% appointments, while the call describes up to4 for full-time
equivalent positions. [s4] [s6] [s7]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Full Grant requires a separate email application and two letters in addition to the ordinary university MSc
application. The doctoral job call itself is the funding competition and requires its specific online form. [s4] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Project-specific doctoral jobs and short-stay master’s scholarships may be advertised separately. Ada Lovelace
doctoral add-on positions offer an additional25% TV-L E13 and require a qualifying doctoral position; the
autumn 2026 deadline was November 1. Eligibility for this gender-diversity award must be checked individually
rather than assumed from ordinary admission. [s4] [s5] [s7]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No application fee is stated in the mathematics MSc or doctoral instructions checked, but an explicit
mathematics-wide zero-fee confirmation was not established. Tuition is zero; semester contribution EUR369.50
for winter 2026-27 is an enrollment charge, not an application fee. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s8]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No application-fee waiver procedure is published in these mathematics instructions. AStA hardship counseling
may help with the semester contribution; that is a different charge. [s8]

text:
University of Münster
Germany · MSc Mathematics Münster; Mathematics Münster Graduate School doctoral positions
Selected European research fit; not a US News ranked-program claim.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• The November 1, 2026 doctoral call has already closed.
• Full Grant funding is a separate May 31 application with two letters; ordinary MSc admission alone does not
request them.
• A US bachelor’s does not automatically satisfy the doctoral degree requirement.
• Keep the academic admission, scholarship email and doctoral-job workflows separate.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a recognized mathematics/comparable bachelor’s of at least six semesters, including120 ECTS in
mathematics; final German-equivalent grade3.0 or better (department says US GPA2.0 equivalent). Provisional
transcripts may be submitted with3.3 or better, but final degree is required for enrollment. UChicago is a
plausible degree route; credit equivalence is assessed, not automatic. Doctoral calls normally presuppose
master’s-level qualification; direct UChicago bachelor eligibility is not established. [s1] [s5] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
For MSc, prepare CV, transcripts/syllabi, English evidence and the department questionnaire; complete online
application, then follow its emailed upload checklist. Submit the separate full-grant request if seeking funding.
If Chinese/Indian/Vietnamese academic history or nationality applies, clarify APS requirements for a US-earned
degree. For a doctorate, identify at least two local investigators and wait for an open call; the November 2026
round has closed. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For MSc, no advance adviser acceptance is required; questionnaire records mentor preference. Doctoral
applicants must name at least two local investigators. Active investigators below include professors and
nonprofessorial researchers; the latter’s independent-supervision authority and 2027 availability must be
confirmed. [s3] [s6] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc has a two-stage workflow: submit the online form, receive an emailed check sheet/application number,
then finish mandatory and optional-or-waived uploads in the info portal. Once complete, files cannot be
exchanged by the applicant. Multiple online submissions leave only the highest application number valid.
Check status weekly. Doctoral calls use a distinct online form. [s2] [s6]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Doctoral autumn 2026 deadline and latest autumn 2027 start are explicit, and the call is already closed as of
November 5. MSc admission and Full Grant use standing annual dates; the detailed scholarship PDF is 2026,
not a newly announced 2027 competition. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6] [s25]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc winter entry: May-July 15, standing annual schedule; no exact 2027 clock/time zone published. Early round
ends around late May/early June. Summer: November-January 15, with first round November 30; the central
calendar explicitly includes January 15, 2027. Doctoral autumn 2026 call: November 1, 2026, now closed; start
no later than autumn 2027. Spring 2027 call date is not yet established. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s24]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc Full Grant: May 31 annually, earlier than the ordinary July 15 admission deadline;2027 call not yet
independently posted. Doctoral funding and position application share the call deadline; the November 1, 2026
round has already closed. No 2027 spring deadline is inferred. [s4] [s5] [s25]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Full Grant: two professor letters sent directly by May 31 annual deadline; no separate grace or clock published.
Doctoral call: at least two letters by November 1, 2026, same as the closed application deadline. Ordinary MSc
checklist does not request letters. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
English proof is part of the required application uploads. The MSc portal check sheet specifies the upload
deadline; do not assume a later score grace period. No GRE requirement is listed. Doctoral English evidence
was due with the closed November 1 call. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete mandatory MSc uploads by the individual check-sheet deadline; final bachelor’s certificate must be
available at enrollment. Originals plus certified German/English translations are combined in one PDF up to2MB
where translation is required. Doctoral call required complete degree/transcript/English materials by its
deadline. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
MSc enrollment/acceptance date is individual and not established here. Doctoral offers arrive by email:
acknowledge receipt promptly; hiring preparation begins at least eight weeks before the agreed start. No
universal April 15 commitment protection is stated. [s2] [s5]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc English B2: TOEFL iBT>=72 on the old scale, IELTS>=6.0, or an English-language bachelor’s. No German
requirement is listed for this English MSc. Doctoral call asks fluent English, no German; certificates or
transcripts showing English instruction/coursework are accepted. [s1] [s5] [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
The MSc explicitly accepts an English-language bachelor’s, so a completed UChicago degree fits. Confirmation
is still needed for the proof accepted while the degree is pending. Doctoral FAQ also accepts English-taught
coursework recorded in the transcript; no separate test is automatically needed under that route. [s1] [s5]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No GRE requirement appears in the complete public MSc checklist or doctoral call. Optional score consideration
is not expressly described; do not assume a score upload is requested. [s1] [s6]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: bachelor’s/provisional certificate and transcript with grades/GPA; syllabus or course descriptions
document the mathematical content. Doctoral call: copies of bachelor’s and master’s certificates and full
transcripts. The mathematics-credit requirement needs an ECTS-equivalence assessment of UChicago quarter
courses. [s1] [s2] [s6]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required questionnaire records degree subject, major/minor, grade, institution and graduation year; select
three intended specializations and indicate whether their prerequisites are already satisfied. It also asks
whether you prefer a theoretical or applied mentor. [s3]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Syllabus/course descriptions are explicitly included among MSc evidence of academic achievements. No
separate page limit is public; central translated-document uploads have a2MB PDF limit. Follow the
program-specific slots. [s1] [s2]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: no letters on the published required checklist. Full Grant scholarship: two university-professor
letters. Doctoral call: at least two recommendation letters. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
The Full Grant adds two professor references to the ordinary MSc application. The doctoral referee guidance
asks, in paraphrase, about relationship duration, mathematical/intellectual ability, independence, work
habits/teamwork, English, and willingness to host the applicant at the referee’s own institution. [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
No automatic invitation is documented for these routes. The applicant personally arranges direct referee email:
scholarship letters to mm.scholarships@uni-muenster.de; doctoral letters to
mm.applications@uni-muenster.de. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Letters are independently emailed and need not wait for academic submission under the published process.
Ensure staff can match the applicant and route; the full-grant email subject must include FULL-GRANT. [s4] [s5]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
Doctoral online application generates an automatic confirmation, but this does not establish letter receipt. The
MSc info portal tracks academic-application status; a separate public scholarship/doctoral letter checklist was
not established. Request receipt confirmation from the relevant office if needed. [s2] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Automatic cross-route/cycle reuse and replacement of a received letter are not promised. Referees should
send fresh route-specific PDFs or ask the receiving office. MSc applicant uploads lock when the file is complete;
only the Master’s Office can exchange them afterward. [s2] [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required for MSc and doctoral applications. No public length/font/spacing rule; upload under the corresponding
form instructions. [s1] [s6]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc checklist has no separate SOP. Doctoral application requires a cover letter, without a public

word/page limit or detailed prompt; explain research fit and name at least two local investigators as required
elsewhere in the form. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list [Unresolved]
No separate required document is specified in the MSc checklist, Full Grant instructions or doctoral call.
Optional attachment/link permission and any live-form limit remain unverified. [s1] [s4] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
MSc questionnaire selects three specializations and prerequisite readiness. Doctoral application must identify
at least two potential local supervisors; no standalone research-interest essay limit is published. [s3] [s6]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Doctoral applicants are invited to include examples of academic work where appropriate. No public length/file
cap or instruction to upload rather than link was established. Ordinary MSc checklist does not require a thesis
or paper. [s1] [s6]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Complete the currently linked two-page questionnaire and attach it; also provide transcript/syllabus evidence.
The questionnaire is not replaced by a freeform course list. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
Full Grant requires a separate motivation letter explaining why you want to pursue the Münster MSc (prompt
paraphrase). Send with the funding request to mm.scholarships@uni-muenster.de, subject containing
FULL-GRANT. No published word/page/font/spacing rule. Second-year renewal later requires a two-page
activity report and transcript. [s4]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No further public short-answer essay was identified beyond the questionnaire, funding motivation and doctoral
cover letter. The academic portal may require additional program-specific uploads shown only after application
submission. [s2] [s3]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc Full Grant: EUR992/month, equivalent to EUR11,904 over12 funded months (arithmetic), plus a one-time
origin-dependent travel allowance and semester fee. Competitive, not automatic. Doctoral positions:75% TV-L
E13 employment for three years; exact annual gross/net euro amount depends on pay scale/step and is not
published in the call. MSc tuition is zero; winter 2026-27 semester fee EUR369.50, not a confirmed 2027-28
charge. [s4] [s6] [s7] [s8]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full Grant is12+12 months, with second-year renewal conditional on positive review of the report/transcript.
Doctoral employment is three years, not a general guarantee of all time needed for completion. [s4] [s6]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Full Grant targets international master’s students; first degree must be completed before funding starts, and
prior residence in Germany cannot exceed12 months during the preceding three years. US F-1 status alone
does not violate that condition. Doctoral call welcomes applicants regardless of nationality. [s4] [s6]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full Grant selection considers academic excellence/motivation and may include an online interview; renewal
requires progress review. Doctoral employment supports research and may include teaching: the standing
funding page says up to3 hours/week for 75% appointments, while the call describes up to4 for full-time
equivalent positions. [s4] [s6] [s7]

Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Full Grant requires a separate email application and two letters in addition to the ordinary university MSc
application. The doctoral job call itself is the funding competition and requires its specific online form. [s4] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Project-specific doctoral jobs and short-stay master’s scholarships may be advertised separately. Ada Lovelace
doctoral add-on positions offer an additional25% TV-L E13 and require a qualifying doctoral position; the
autumn 2026 deadline was November 1. Eligibility for this gender-diversity award must be checked individually
rather than assumed from ordinary admission. [s4] [s5] [s7]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No application fee is stated in the mathematics MSc or doctoral instructions checked, but an explicit
mathematics-wide zero-fee confirmation was not established. Tuition is zero; semester contribution EUR369.50
for winter 2026-27 is an enrollment charge, not an application fee. [s1] [s2] [s6] [s8]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No application-fee waiver procedure is published in these mathematics instructions. AStA hardship counseling
may help with the semester contribution; that is a different charge. [s8]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
MSc grade3.0 final versus3.3 provisional are distinct stages, not interchangeable thresholds. Central APS
wording refers broadly to applicants from China/India/Vietnam and does not clarify this UChicago-degree
scenario. Old faculty/group membership pages are checked against current institutional investigators and
personal pages. [s1] [s2] [s9] [s10]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm UChicago ECTS mapping, pending-degree English proof, APS applicability,2027 Full Grant call and
clock, letter receipt/replacement, application-fee amount, scholarship acceptance date, and whether a
bachelor’s-only doctoral exception exists. Check the next doctoral call instead of using the closed November
2026 form.
